adhkar_items.title: Morning gratitude
adhkar_items.arabic:
أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
adhkar_items.translation:
We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion belongs to Allah and all praise is due to Allah
There is no god but Allah alone without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise and He is over all things capable
My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the difficulties of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Hellfire and the punishment of the grave
adhkar_items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillahi wal hamdu lillah la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadha al-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dahu wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha al-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dahu. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal kasali wa su'il kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nar wa adhabin fil-qabr.

adhkar_items.title: Infinite Praiser
adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata arshihi wa midada kalimatihi

adhkar_items.title: Morning Reliance
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, and by You we enter the evening, by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namut wa ilaykan-nushoor

adhkar_items.title: Affirmation of Faith
adhkar_items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
adhkar_items.translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion (Shahadah), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Abraham, who was upright and a Muslim, and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-Islam wa kalimatil-ikhlas wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam wa ala millati abina Ibrahim hanifan Musliman wa ma kana min al-mushrikeen

adhkar_items.title: Tawheed and Protection
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَىٰ مُسْلِمٍ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah Creator of the heavens and the earth Knower of the unseen and the seen there is no god but You Lord and Owner of everything I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself from the evil of Shaytan and his traps and from bringing harm upon myself or dragging it onto another Muslim
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma fatiras samawati wal ard ʿalimal ghaybi wash shahadah la ilaha illa anta rabbakulli shay’in wa malikahu aʿudhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharri ash shaytani wa shirkih wa an aqtarifa ʿala nafsi su’an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

adhkar_items.title: Dua for Contentment
adhkar_items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
adhkar_items.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Raditu billahi rabban wa bil-islami dinan wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyan

adhkar_items.title: Protection Dua
adhkar_items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
adhkar_items.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing
adhkar_items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'ul alim

adhkar_items.title: Wellbeing & Health
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, grant well-being to my body. O Allah, grant well-being to my hearing. O Allah, grant well-being to my sight. There is no deity but You.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma aafini fi badani Allahumma aafini fi sam'i Allahumma aafini fi basari la ilaha illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Dua for Forgiveness
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity except You.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr wa a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabr la ilaha illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Total dependence on Allah
adhkar_items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
adhkar_items.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astagheeth aslih li sha'ni kullah wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn

adhkar_items.title: Sayyid ul Astaghfar
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to You Your blessings upon me, and I admit to You my sins, so forgive me, for surely no one forgives sins except You.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduk wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika ma ista'ta't a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't aboo'u laka bini'matika alayya wa aboo'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Protection from harm
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter O Allah I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs and my family and my wealth O Allah conceal my faults and calm my fears O Allah protect me from in front of me and from behind me and from my right and from my left and from above me and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afwa wal-afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali Allahumma astur ‘awrati wa amin raw‘ati Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali wa min fawqi wa a‘udhu bi ‘azamatika an ughtala min tahti

adhkar_items.title: Remembrance
adhkar_items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar_items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.
adhkar_items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir

adhkar_items.title: Lightest yet Heaviest
adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi

adhkar_items.title: Dhikr: Astaghfirullah
adhkar_items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar_items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh

adhkar_items.title: Evening gratitude
adhkar_items.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ، وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, we have entered the evening and so has the dominion, all belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone without partner. To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the hardships of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah walhamdu lillah. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah. Lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadhihi al-laylah wa khayra ma ba'daha. Wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihi al-laylah wa sharri ma ba'daha. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal kasal wa su'il kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nar wa adhabin fil-qabr.

adhkar_items.title: Evening Reliance
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we reach the morning. By Your leave we live and by Your leave we die. And to You is the return.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namut wa ilaykal maseer.

adhkar_items.title: Affirmation of Faith
adhkar_items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
adhkar_items.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, and the word of sincere devotion, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our forefather Ibrahim, who was upright and a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Amsayna ala fitratil Islam wa kalimatil ikhlas wa ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallam wa ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal mushrikeen.

adhkar_items.title: Protection Dua
adhkar_items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

adhkar_items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'ul alim

adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr wa a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabr la ilaha illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Evening Protection Duʿa
adhkar_items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
adhkar_items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahi tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

adhkar_items.title: Wellbeing & Health
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, grant well-being to my body. O Allah, grant well-being to my hearing. O Allah, grant well-being to my sight. There is no deity but You.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma aafini fi badani Allahumma aafini fi sam'i Allahumma aafini fi basari la ilaha illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Total dependence on Allah
adhkar_items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
adhkar_items.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astagheeth aslih li sha'ni kullah wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn

adhkar_items.title: Sayyid ul Astaghfar
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to You Your blessings upon me, and I admit to You my sins, so forgive me, for surely no one forgives sins except You.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduk wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika ma ista'ta't a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't aboo'u laka bini'matika alayya wa aboo'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta

adhkar_items.title: Protection from harm
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter O Allah I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs and my family and my wealth O Allah conceal my faults and calm my fears O Allah protect me from in front of me and from behind me and from my right and from my left and from above me and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afwa wal-afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali Allahumma astur ‘awrati wa amin raw‘ati Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali wa min fawqi wa a‘udhu bi ‘azamatika an ughtala min tahti

adhkar_items.title: Remembrance
adhkar_items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar_items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.
adhkar_items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir

adhkar_items.title: Lightest yet Heaviest
adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi

adhkar_items.title: Dhikr: Astaghfirullah
adhkar_items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar_items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh

adhkar_items.title: Sleeping Dua
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma bismika amootu wa ahya

adhkar_items.title: Salawat
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad

adhkar_items.title: Astaghfirullah
adhkar_items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar_items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh

adhkar_items.title: Short durood
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad

adhkar_items.title: Reflecting on peace
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma anta as-salaamu wa minka as-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam

adhkar_items.title: Subhanallah
adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory be to Allah
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subhanallah

adhkar_items.title: Alhamdulilah
adhkar_items.arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar_items.translation: All praise is due to Allah
adhkar_items.transliteration: Alhamdulilah

adhkar_items.title: Allahu Akbar
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
adhkar_items.translation: Allah is the greatest
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar

adhkar_items.title: Purification of tongue and heart
adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih

adhkar_items.title: Remembrance
adhkar_items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
adhkar_items.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, and He has no partner
adhkar_items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah

adhkar_items.title: Dua before sleeping
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma bismika amootu wa ahya

adhkar_items.title: Dua after waking up
adhkar_items.arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
adhkar_items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba’da ma amatana wa ilayhi an-nushoor

adhkar_items.title: Dua when entering the house
adhkar_items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
adhkar_items.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna

adhkar_items.title: Dua when exiting the house
adhkar_items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
adhkar_items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallah wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

adhkar_items.title: Dua when entering the bathroom
adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from male and female devils.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khabaith

adhkar_items.title: Dua when leaving the bathroom
adhkar_items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Ghufranaka

adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
adhkar_items.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah. And Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah belongs all praise.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahil hamd

adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, forgive me, grant me wellbeing, and provide for me.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li wa aafini warzuqni

adhkar_items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
adhkar_items.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Surely, all praise, blessings, and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, labbaika la sharika laka labbaik, inna al-ḥamda wa ni‘mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak

adhkar_items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ
adhkar_items.translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh

adhkar_items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي
adhkar_items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and have mercy on me.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī warḥamnī

adhkar_items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīran

adhkar_items.arabic: الْـحَمْدُ للهِ
adhkar_items.translation: All praise is due to Allah.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh

adhkar_items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, all praise is due to You as is befitting to Your Majesty and Great Authority.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allāhumma laka al-ḥamdu kamā yanbaghī li-jalāli wajhika wa ʿaẓīmi sulṭānik

adhkar_items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
adhkar_items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya innaka anta at-tawwābu ar-raḥīm

adhkar_items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
adhkar_items.translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day of Reckoning.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-muʾminīn yawma yaqūmu al-ḥisāb

adhkar_items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
adhkar_items.translation: O Allah, forgive all my sins, the small and great, the first and last, the open and secret.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrahu

adhkar_items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
adhkar_items.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many times as the number of His creations, His pleasure, the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
adhkar_items.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdihi ʿadada khalqihi wa riḍā nafsihi wa zinata ʿarshihi wa midāda kalimātihi
